subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should Mattermost history reads be enabled for existing configurations by default, and should the core retain a Mattermost-specific action-level authorization exception for that behavior?
rationale: This is an upgrade-time capability expansion coupled to a cross-owner authorization boundary; source inspection can show the behavior but cannot choose the intended trust and rollout policy.

options.title: Preserve existing action availability
options.body: Require an explicit `actions.messages: true` opt-in for existing installations while documenting or onboarding fresh setups deliberately.

options.title: Approve the default-on exception
options.body: Accept existing-install default-on reads and the Mattermost-specific core gate with explicit upgrade, security, and owner sign-off.

options.title: Pause for a generic audited contract
options.body: Defer merging until maintainers define a reusable but tightly constrained bundled-provider authorization contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing action availability
recommendation.body: Require an explicit `actions.messages: true` opt-in for existing installations while documenting or onboarding fresh setups deliberately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Mattermost and channel-policy work makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the core authorization and upgrade decision.
